proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 3 ≤ N → 3 ∣ N → M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.P3Family.recipe N) = M8.P3Family.polynomial
  intro N inst hN hdiv
  have hp : M8.P3Family.polynomial.Monic := by
    apply Polynomial.monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one 2
    · unfold M8.P3Family.polynomial
      compute_degree
    · simp [M8.P3Family.polynomial, Polynomial.coeff_add]
  have hd := M8.P3Family.divides_modulus N hdiv
  have hl := M8.P3Family.literal_polynomial N hN
  unfold M7.RecipeSignature.signature
  dsimp only [M8.P3Family.recipe]
  simp only [hl]
  first
  | change gcd (gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial M8.P3Family.polynomial) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) = M8.P3Family.polynomial
  | change gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial (gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)) = M8.P3Family.polynomial
  | change gcd (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) (gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial M8.P3Family.polynomial) = M8.P3Family.polynomial
  | change normalize (gcd (gcd M8.P3Family.polynomial M8.P3Family.polynomial) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)) = M8.P3Family.polynomial
  simp [gcd_self, gcd_eq_left hd, gcd_eq_right hd, hp.normalize_eq]
